verdict.rationale: Runloop shows fan-out at scale: a single CLI benchmark job provisions many devboxes, runs agents, scores and aggregates results, and can compare multiple agents in one command. It also advertises 10k+ parallel sandboxes and supports snapshot fan-out and blueprint reuse across many devboxes. However, there is no evidence of general-purpose bulk operations on existing resources, such as batch execute, suspend, or delete across many devboxes. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API or CLI commands for acting on many devboxes or resources at once, bulk command execution across devboxes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
